:::{#lem-prob-from-odds}
#### The odds over one plus the odds is the probability

Let $A$ be an [event](#def-event) with [probability](#def-probability) $\P(A) \in (0, 1)$
and [odds](#def-odds) $\odds$.
The odds of $A$ over one plus the odds of $A$ is the probability of $A$:

$$\frac{\odds}{1 + \odds} = \P(A).$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\frac{\odds}{1 + \odds}
&= \odds \cdot \frac{1}{1 + \odds}
&& \text{(} \tfrac{a}{b} = a \cdot \tfrac{1}{b} \text{)}
\\&= \odds \cdot (1 - \P(A))
&& \text{(one over one plus the odds)}
\\&= \frac{\P(A)}{1 - \P(A)} \cdot (1 - \P(A))
&& \text{(definition of the odds)}
\\&= \P(A)
&& \text{(} \tfrac{a}{b} \cdot b = a \text{)}
\ea
$$

The second step applies @lem-complement-from-odds.

:::
